configuration_initial_values_evidence: reports/board/pds/audit.json verifies mapped GRS/INIT for reset hold and release synchronizers; not a physical power-up test
confirmation_evidence: Cross-checked against same-board reference project D:/Maximus/game/purple-light-fpga-main (PCIe DMA example, verified working). Identical ball assignments; adopted its verified IO levels as authoritative on 2026-09-23.
resolved: V4 sys_clk BANKR5 = 1.5V: reference project drives V4 at 1.5V (SSTL15_I); our LVCMOS15 single-ended input on the same 1.5V bank is compatible. Oscillator 1.8V annotation is a separate supply rail, not the bank VCCIO.
M15/M16/J16/M17 (KEY/LED) BANKL4 = 1.8V: reference project defines all four balls as LVCMOS18. Corrected board_io_reference.fdc from LVCMOS33 to LVCMOS18 on 2026-09-23.
UART AB21/AB22 = 3.3V: same balls are ordinary 3.3V IO in the reference project; expansion connector identity/orientation and pin availability accepted as usable per reference project.
